title: Analyzing Long Running Operation (SQL Query) Telemetry

facts.text: SQL queries taking over 750 milliseconds are automatically sent to Azure Application Insights for analysis.
Additional logging can be enabled from the Help & Support page to capture all SQL queries for short periods.
For Business Central online, additional logging requires version 17.4 or later.
For Business Central on-premises, additional logging requires version 18.6 or later.
AL Stack Trace in CustomDimensions shows which AL objects and code executed the slow SQL query.
The event severity level for long running queries is always 2, indicating a warning.
SQL statement values exceeding 8192 characters are truncated while preserving the most relevant information.
